newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Foncier offer date extended by CDC.
newsitem.headline: Credit Foncier offer date extended by CDC.

text.p: France's CBV bourse regulator said on Wednesday it was extending the period of the takeover offer launched by state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations for Credit Foncier de France, which the state plans to wind down.

The CBV issued a statement, saying it would extend the deadline -- originally set as October 4 -- until the end of five bourse opening days after a court ruling on certain proceedings linked to the offer.

The CDC is offering 70 francs a share for Credit Foncier under a government plan for a "managed wind-down" of the latter after large losses and provisions in 1995 and despite a profit in the first half of 1996.
